scope: Selected compiled call paths for discarded source functions; native equivalence remains separately qualified

reviewed_paths.evidence: The retained target body contains the aligned word loop and tail byte comparison from the selected source; no memcmp call remains.
The retained target body contains CRC32 polynomial 0xedb88320 and inline byte/bit loops; no CRC32 call remains.
The selected power-control adapter supplies an INTEN read/clear/write callback after the parent's handle validation.
The retained target body calls critical-save and ring-add, with no separate collector call; source collector is inlined.
The retained target body calls critical-save and pump, with no separate claim call; source claim is inlined.
Target body branches after pll_integer and directly calls ceil, mod, round, and floor from the selected fractional branch; fraction source is inlined.

Selected class-6 release source includes static pll_disable; retained target disassembly 0x412556..0x41257e checks 0x01504c30, reads/writes 0x400204d8 clearing bit29, rereads handle and clears bit25. The standalone API section duplicates this path.
Native formatter invokes memchr(pointer,0,precision); selected format engine uses bounded byte scan for the same string precision behavior.

Selected source calls clock_configure for enable/restore. The retained target configure body calls clock_request and clock_release and performs the register path, with no separate clock_configure call; compiler inlined it.

Stock formatter tests length modifier with strchr("hjltzL", current byte), including terminal NUL. Selected parser switch handles h,j,l,t,z,L and NUL directly, then handles hh/ll; standalone strchr section is not required for this source path.

Stock formatter calls 0x422590 on invalid secure %n/argument; selected engine constraint() loads handler cell 0x20027190, invokes it with message/0/34 or aborts, and returns -1 from caller. The wrapper section is redundant to this source path.

Selected mutex-take source calls mutex_inherit when owner priority must rise; retained target mutex-take body has no separate inherit BL, so the compiled path is inlined. Full native/source body audit of 0x418b7c was previously bound.
Selected runtime_action checks thread_state before deletion; retained target body calls context guard and thread_delete without a separate thread_state BL, so the state branch is inlined.
Selected RTOS heap source calls insert after split and free; both retained target bodies have no separate insert BL, so coalescing is compiled inline.

Stock 0x415844 is the unsigned 64-bit divide-by-ten quotient helper called by the digit-width/string bodies 0x415900/0x4159a0. Selected pinned plain_printf.c has static divu64_10 with the same shift/add/remainder correction, including a 32-bit fast path, and retained uint64_to_str invokes that local helper. The standalone source section duplicates this path.

Selected dispatch source calls aligned MRAM child after destination/count checks. Retained target dispatch body calls critical-save, guard-begin, actual MRAM lower, and guard-end, with no separate aligned call; compiler inlined the child.

Selected thread initialize source calls the exact initial Cortex-M frame builder with top/base/entry/arg. Retained target 0x426e2e..0x426e6e performs the eighteen frame stores directly, including xPSR, entry, task-return, synthetic registers, EXC_RETURN and base; no child call. This proves inlining/path retention for the discarded standalone section, not stock runtime equivalence of the whole thread path.

Selected wait source calls NOR busy status in both the initial 200-iteration and count-controlled loops. Retained target 0x421dbc..0x421ec0 contains two direct calls to opencfw_bl_mspi_status_transfer at 0x421e22 and 0x421ea8, with failure logger branches and low status-bit tests, and no standalone busy call. The discarded busy section was inlined into wait; native stock 0x42074e separately describes the same status test. Whole NOR runtime behavior remains separately qualified.

Selected IRQ row source calls RX drain for status bits 0x10 and 0x40. Retained target row 0x41d920..0x41d9dc has both direct FIFO calls, including 0x41d9b0 for the 16-byte notify path, followed by count accumulation, optional callback via blx, and count reset. No standalone drain call remains; child body is inlined. Native stock 0x41f776 source separately records same path, but whole IRQ runtime equality remains an independent gate.

Selected mode-leave source calls release-needed after clearing the descriptor bit. Retained target mode-leave 0x422abc onward directly repeats descriptor-copy at 0x422b8e, then branches through group/register tests before the status poll at 0x422ba0; no release-needed call remains. This is compile path/inlining evidence, with MMIO ordering and native full-body equivalence retained as separate gates.

Retained clock_request id-0 table arm 0x4128fe..0x41293e directly tests user bit, saves/disables PRIMASK, sets bookkeeping bit, restores PRIMASK, returns zero. Other id arms tail-call their functions. This is the selected id-0 child inlined into the dispatch parent.

Retained clock_release id-0 table arm 0x41299a..0x4129dc directly tests user bit, saves/disables PRIMASK, clears bookkeeping bit, restores PRIMASK, returns zero. Other id arms tail-call their functions. This is the selected id-0 child inlined into the dispatch parent.

The selected timer service mode-2 branch calls sequence2b. Retained target 0x42559c..0x425606 contains all selected child effects inline: three ordered cached MMIO field writes at 0x40020044/80/80, delay 5, separate clears at 0x4002037c, 0x4002004c field write, and state-byte 26 store, then shared spot-stop. No standalone sequence2b call remains. This is target compiled-path evidence, while stock-vs-source MMIO timing remains separately bounded.

Retained target IRQ dispatcher 0x41d8a8..0x41d8e8 reads the module status register, ORs captured status, branches by 0x40/0x80/0x100/0x200/0x400/0x1000 priorities to 0x08000006..0b, then invokes callback via blx. This is selected DMA-error child inlined into dispatcher.

Retained target IRQ dispatcher 0x41d880..0x41d89c writes zero to base+0x48, clears bit 0x20 at base+4 and low 12 bits at base+0x50 on status 0x1000. This is selected DMA RX stop child inlined into dispatcher.

Retained target IRQ dispatcher 0x41d8f2..0x41d90c writes zero to base+0x48, then separately clears bits 0x10 and 0x20 at base+4 after callback handling. This is selected DMA disable child inlined into dispatcher.

Retained allocator 0x427df2..0x427e34 tests uninitialized END then directly writes START, END, initial free block, FREE and MINFREE using the authenticated 0x20000560/0x20014550 aligned bounds. No standalone initialize call remains.

Retained CMSIS delay 0x433902..0x433940 contains kernel-delay body: scheduler locked check and fault, suspend, task-block(ticks,0), resume, conditional reschedule. No standalone kernel_delay call remains.

Selected scatter callback bodies call source-owned range_valid, which duplicates the separately named stock 0x430a60 body. Retained read/program target bodies call device-info query at 0x41146a/0x4114d2 and compare address against 0x4000 at 0x411472/0x4114da, then compare size to cached limit. The standalone address_validate section is discarded because the callback module has an equivalent local function and Clang inlined it. This establishes the source path, not hardware range policy.

Selected class-2 request calls callback-finish on both existing-user and newly-added-user paths. Retained target 0x411786..0x4117a2 and 0x4118ec..0x411906 each checks active, calls clock_wait_active, saves/disables PRIMASK, clears active byte and callback pointer, and restores PRIMASK, with no standalone finish call. This is compiled-path proof; radio timing remains separate.

Stock thread-name getter 0x418372 is called by logger metadata wrapper 0x41a6c2. Selected logger metadata wrappers implement the same current-task name path directly. Retained target elog_port_get_p_info 0x417e28..0x417e56 checks runtime mode, calls current_task, returns task+0x34, and executes native fatal policy on zero. The standalone getter is a duplicate selected path; wrapper runtime equivalence remains separately qualified.

Stock mount/update body 0x421210 calls lfs_file_rewind. Selected boot-count source calls lfs_file_seek(fs,file,0,LFS_SEEK_SET), and retained target 0x4130e0 calls selected lfs_file_seek. Pinned LittleFS lfs_file_rewind_ itself calls lfs_file_seek_(...,0,LFS_SEEK_SET) and returns 0 on success; seek returns 0 for this successful position. Stock result is ignored. This is the same pinned operation path, not a missing source body.

Retained tag-level body 0x416dbc..0x416dde checks lock mode and active lock state, calls service_wake at 0x416dcc when needed, and sets lock byte; retained output has the same direct service_wake path at 0x417610. No standalone lock call remains.

Selected logger source calls unlock after tag-level and output handling. Retained output directly calls service_sleep at 0x417dcc and clears lock state without an unlock call. The standalone source helper is inlined into retained logger paths; other exits remain subject to full formatter/runtime qualification.

Retained mutex-take 0x4270ae..0x4270c4 reads current TCB cell 0x20027134, conditionally increments task word25 at +100, rereads current TCB and stores queue owner. This is selected claim-current child inlined into the semaphore success path.

Retained mutex-take 0x42725a..0x42726c checks queue wait list at +36, returns zero for empty or computes 56 minus head priority through +48 and a dereference before calling disinherit_timeout. This is selected waiter-priority helper inlined into timeout path.

Selected idle timer source has sample_three with the same PRIMASK-protected three volatile loads as stock 0x422aac. Retained target counter_read 0x43307c..0x43308c and timer_compare 0x4330a6..0x4330b8 directly perform three reads of 0x40008804 with PRIMASK save/restore; no standalone snapshot call remains.

Selected STIMER IRQ vector calls irq_status(0). Retained target 0x41cf78..0x41cf86 reads raw 0x40008904 and tests bit zero before clearing and handling it, with no standalone irq_status call. This is the unmasked native path used by the vector.

Selected class-2 clock request samples RADIO_MODE_REGISTER into a mode byte. Retained target 0x4117b6..0x4117ca directly loads 0x4002012c, tests bit8 first to choose mode2, otherwise preserves bit0 as mode1/0, then branches by selector. No standalone sample call remains.

Stock hook0c slot 0x20026e44 is selected power_hook_begin. Retained mode-enter 0x4229c6..0x4229d4 loads callback from base 0x20026e3c+8 and conditionally blx, with no standalone startup_hook0c call; source leave uses same wrapper path.

Stock hook10 slot 0x20026e48 is selected power_hook_end. Retained mode-enter 0x422a5e..0x422a64 loads callback from base 0x20026e3c+12 and conditionally blx after PRIMASK restore, with no standalone startup_hook10 call; source leave uses same wrapper path.

Selected port timer configure calls gate_enable(1). Retained target 0x4235f0..0x4235f8 directly reads 0x40008900 (base 0x40008800+0x100), ORs bit1 and writes it back, with no standalone gate child call.

Stock 0x4213d8 is a two-byte BX LR identity leaf for MRAM INFO0 word offset. Selected info-read dispatch calls the same identity source helper, but target 0x4113dc..0x4113de directly forms base 0x42000000 plus word_offset<<2, with no helper call. This is exact identity inlining, not a missing body.

Pinned TLSF defines tlsf_pool_overhead as 2*block_header_overhead, a compile-time constant consumed by add_pool. Retained target add_pool 0x429a5a..0x429a6a folds this overhead into its aligned pool-size calculation and has no call to the four-byte getter. This is source-owned constant folding, not a missing runtime provider.

Stock 0x423342 wrapper supplies FIFO count32, null destination/out and preserves saved R7 as high return R1. Selected DMA recovery calls uart_rx_fifo(context,0,0x20,null) and discards its return; retained target 0x41d7be calls FIFO directly before RX cancel at 0x41d7c4. Because the caller ignores both return words, the standalone register-preserving wrapper is not needed on this selected path. Do not generalize its ABI to other callers.

The source-owned decompressed callback table relocates the DFU deinit slot to opencfw_boot_dfu_thread_deinit_native, not the duplicate context.c void helper. Retained target 0x4260e4..0x4260fe twice reads handle 0x200004d4, conditionally calls terminate, clears handle, and returns zero. That is the stock 0x42ddda callback path; the duplicate section may be discarded without losing the registered entry.

reviewed_paths.retained_caller: pinned tlsf.c builtin FLS branch in retained TLSF bodies
reviewed_paths.evidence: Stock uses pinned TLSF generic highest-set-bit source branch; selected Clang pin chooses tlsf_fls=word?(32-clz(word)):0 then subtracts one. Both yield bit_length(word)-1 including zero=-1. Selected retained TLSF target contains CLZ in allocation paths (for example 0x429cae/0x429cca). Reproducible 100006-case pure-value check passes; standalone generic branch is an alternative compile path, not required as a separate call.

reviewed_paths.retained_caller: pinned tlsf.c builtin FLS branch in retained TLSF bodies
reviewed_paths.evidence: Stock generic wrapper returns fls_generic(word)-1. Selected pinned Clang branch returns (word?32-CLZ(word):0)-1 and retained target uses CLZ in TLSF paths. The source expressions agree for all uint32 by highest-set-bit identity, with zero=-1; 100006 bounded values are checked. This is branch equivalence, not proof of whole allocator runtime behavior.

Stock root 0x41c4b4 reaches raw-register clockmux entry 0x41acb2. Selected ABI root captures ambient R5/R7 in typed startup_root_register_carry_t, builds the clockmux carry with explicit values, and retained target 0x42607e calls the full selected am_hal_pwrctrl_low_power_init_clockmux_fragment at 0x41aa90. The separate raw-entry register-rotation veneer is not called because the selected C root consumes the carry object directly. This proves selected source path ownership, not complete stock register/return equivalence outside bounded startup oracle.

Stock formatter 0x41e47a calls 0x422874 and dereferences the returned 0x20000518 TLS anchor at offset 0x24 to load the current decimal-character pointer and byte. Selected retained float_render.c directly dereferences the same volatile pointer slot at 0x2000053c. This is equivalent for the formatter callsite and preserves runtime locale data; standalone anchor need not be called. Other hypothetical anchor callers are outside this bounded proof.

The only native caller of 0x41f2c8 in locked catalogue is formatter 0x41e47a. Its visible padding/zero emission calls pass length 1 and test only the low status word; stock helper calls the callback with current state and byte, stores returned state, fails on zero, and increments count on success. Selected retained engine.c put() performs that same callback/state/failure/count sequence, and repeat() invokes it for each padding byte. This proves these scalar emission callsites; physical stack offsets, the helper's high return word, and whole formatter output remain separately unqualified.

reviewed_paths.retained_caller: selected LittleFS, logger, allocator, RTOS, startup, UART and DFU clear paths
reviewed_paths.evidence: Locked direct-call census records 18 fill calls in 16 callers, all with ignored raw R0 return. Eight calls are in pinned selected LittleFS functions; the other ten bind selected service-record clear, EasyLogger local zero/space initialization, RTOS TCB zero, startup 60-byte callback table clear, allocator 0x70800 arena clear, UART 56-byte descriptor clear, standard memset wrapper, and DFU 40-byte message clear. Selected implementations use memset, zero initialization, or explicit byte loops with the same lengths and fill bytes. For ordinary RAM final-state semantics the standalone IAR backward-fill routine is subsumed; precise write order, concurrent readers, and unusual MMIO destinations remain unqualified.

reviewed_paths.retained_caller: selected pinned LittleFS and six source-owned descriptor/command copies
reviewed_paths.evidence: Locked direct-call census records 29 aligned-copy calls in 18 callers, all ignoring raw R0. Twenty-three callsites reside in twelve selected pinned LittleFS bodies, whose C source owns the relevant struct/cache copies. The remaining six are runtime query table-to-destination, startup clock descriptor-to-stack, NOR command-to-stack, boot-directory record-to-stack, spot transition descriptor-to-stack, and control transaction record-to-stack. The locked helper produces ordinary forward-copy final bytes for 256 nonoverlapping SRAM fixtures across 16 lengths and all 4x4 alignment pairs (verify_iar_direct_copy_final_bytes.py). This covers valid nonoverlapping source calls and final bytes; overlap, concurrent readers, and exact write order remain unqualified.

Stock rotation helper 0x423928 copies a block to 128-byte scratch, shifts an overlapping range with memmove_4276bc, then copies scratch back. Selected qsort.c owns the same initializer sort operation with whole-record swap/rotate and does not call standalone memmove. Fresh current-source M4 differential build (boot-qsort-current-coverage/comparison.json) executes locked stock qsort/comparator and selected qsort, matching complete eight-byte record outputs for 98 deterministic/reverse/random/duplicate/equal-key cases across counts1..256; qsort.c SHA matches the current bounded Boot receipt. This is operation-level final sorted-record ownership for the initializer; exact intermediate write order, concurrent observers, arbitrary widths, and impure comparator effects remain unqualified.

qualification_limits: These paths explain GC of selected standalone sections; they do not prove all native branches or runtime output equal.
Formatter precision and SYSPLL MMIO runtime equality require separate bounded or hardware-dependent evidence.
